name: Animalism — Advanced — Drawing Out the Beast

system.description: While about to frenzy, instead of a Virtue Test you may make a Social Challenge (no action cost) against a visible target. If you win, the victim suffers your frenzy instead of you, and you cannot frenzy while this power is in effect. If the victim leaves your sight, you lose your Beast, cannot spend Willpower Traits, and gain the Negative Trait Submissive x2 until you locate the victim and lure the Beast back. If the victim dies, your Beast returns to you.
